Recorded claim:
Use lower camel case for new JavaScript parameters in these protocol tests and surrounding JS code. D212809 explicitly requested it and the accepted test uses channelName, channelPassword, expectedName and expectedPassword. Existing API fields with other spellings keep their external contract. This is a naming preference beyond formatter output.
